description: This file defines the BugsViewEdit class, which extends ViewEdit, used for editing bug records with some customization related to portal settings. It includes a constructor and a display method that retrieves administration settings and passes a portal flag to the view.

classes.name: BugsViewEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing bug records with additional portal configuration logic, extending the core ViewEdit class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the BugsViewEdit object and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to retrieve admin settings, check if portal is enabled, and assign a flag to the view, then calls the parent display method.
